Remove a dependency from Largo.toml.

Deletes the named entry from `[dependencies]`, leaving the rest of the manifest byte-identical.

Usage: largo remove [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          The dependency name to remove

Options:
  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo remove math_utils
